text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Checkmate! Fufu, this time the victory is 
mine♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, so frustrating! I won just a 
moment ago, too!
choice_data_list: What are the two of you doing together?
What are you two doing together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I was just testing a new app 
that the Satono family is developing—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a chess game, interested? I believe 
there are still some beta testing slots 
left.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK! I'll contact the development team 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, to start off, I'll have 
you try out Spectator Mode—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia, shall we play another match?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Kura-chan. I won't lose this time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I move the bishop on c8 to g4. She's my 
vanguard♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ... Knight to e5. I'll take your pawn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that leave her Queen wide 
open...? Then with my Bishop... wait, is 
this a trap?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it after all—Rook from a7 to a3! 
For now, I'll chip away at Kura-chan's 
pieces!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You walked right into my trap!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Bishop to f7! Thanks to the Rook's move, a 
path has opened up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Checkmate! Your crown is mine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No way... Ugh~, I give up...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Tài hǎo le! This round is my victory too!
choice_data_list: Amazing! That was a brilliant strategy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Thanks! I'm so glad it went well♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That two-step trap was amazing. My pieces 
had nowhere to go, totally cramped."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, Cla-chan's bishop 
moved just like it smoothly broke away 
from the pack—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did you think so too, Dia? While playing, 
I also realized that could be used for 
mind games!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If I make them watch for a feint to hide 
my true aim, I should be able to break 
through on the ideal line...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good! I can't wait to test it 
out in a race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Working as a game tester while honing 
strategic thinking that can be applied to 
racing—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And that is playtesting, our way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Growing stronger through Satono's 
enterprises, and then—surpassing the 
"Satono Jinx."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...It's all to live up to the clan's 
expectations, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is my reason to run, and the 
reason I was born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From their serious gazes as they spoke, I 
could once again feel their desperate 
passion for their long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So there you have it, Trainer! I'm 
counting on your help with races and 
playtesting!
choice_data_list: Let's persevere and keep making effort.

Now that we've decided, there's no time to 
waste!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There are other strategies I'd love 
to try! I'm sure you'll be amazed♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of Kura-chan. Still, I'm 
going to break through!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Now, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer! You get it! 
Even one step ahead, we're gonna get even 
faster!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I can't back down either! Kura-chan, 
let's play one more match!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge! We'll get 
stronger together!!
